scenario_definitions.name: direct
scenario_definitions.description: One robot traverses six metres with no obstacles.

scenario_definitions.name: static_slalom
scenario_definitions.description: One robot crosses a staggered line of three stationary opponents.

scenario_definitions.name: crossing
scenario_definitions.description: Two controlled robots cross at right angles through the origin.

scenario_definitions.name: crossing_oblique_45
scenario_definitions.description: Two controlled robots cross at 45 degrees, heading the same general way.

scenario_definitions.name: crossing_oblique_135
scenario_definitions.description: Two controlled robots cross at 135 degrees, heading broadly towards each other.

scenario_definitions.name: crossing_offset
scenario_definitions.description: Two controlled robots cross at right angles off-centre, so they reach the crossing at different times.

scenario_definitions.name: crossing_steady_runner
scenario_definitions.description: An opponent follows a point crossing our path at a steady 1 m/s.

scenario_definitions.name: overtaking
scenario_definitions.description: One robot overtakes an opponent following a point ahead on the same line at 0.5 m/s.

scenario_definitions.name: grid_intersection
scenario_definitions.description: Two horizontal lanes cross two vertical lanes at four intersections.

scenario_definitions.name: mirror_swap
scenario_definitions.description: Six-versus-six mirrored swap with a deterministic 2 cm symmetry break.

scenario_definitions.name: narrow_passage
scenario_definitions.description: One robot threads a 0.24m gap between two static obstacles.

scenario_definitions.name: head_on_swap
scenario_definitions.description: Two robots swap positions driving directly at each other.

scenario_definitions.name: field_boundary_corner
scenario_definitions.description: Target sits just inside a real field corner.

scenario_definitions.name: defense_area_boundary
scenario_definitions.description: Target sits just outside the enforced defense-area keep-distance.

scenario_definitions.name: interception
scenario_definitions.description: One robot intercepts an opponent-controlled point moving at constant velocity.

scenario_definitions.name: sudden_obstacle
scenario_definitions.description: A corridor is clear for 2s, then an obstacle appears mid-path.

scenario_definitions.name: disturbance_recovery
scenario_definitions.description: A robot is knocked off its planned path partway through and must replan.

scenario_definitions.name: start_inside_obstacle
scenario_definitions.description: A robot begins overlapping a stationary obstacle and must escape to a distant target.

scenario_definitions.name: jittering_target
scenario_definitions.description: The target is recomputed every tick with ~1mm deterministic jitter around a fixed point.
